 Hyderabad vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 Live Streaming: Where to Watch Suryakumar Yadav?
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 14, 2026, 02:32 AM 2 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Suryakumar Yadav Shivam Dube Hyderabad will face Mumbai in their opening match of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026 on Saturday, November 14. The Elite Group D encounter will be played at the Jadavpur University Second Campus Ground in Kolkata from 9:00 AM IST, with both sides looking to begin their campaign with a victory.
 Mumbai will have plenty of star power in their squad, with India's former T20I captain and one of the best T20 batsmen of all time, Suryakumar Yadav, leading the side. This raises the anticipation of this game even more for the fans. Here's everything you need to know about the Hyderabad vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 live streaming and telecast details.
 Where to Watch Hyderabad vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 Live?
 The Hyderabad vs Mumbai SMAT live stream and television broadcast are not available for the fans. The Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy has selected matches streamed live on JioHotstar and televised on the Star Sports Network in previous editions, but that does not guarantee coverage of every fixture.
 The fans who are unable to watch the match live online or from the stadium, can follow Sportsdunia live cricket score for the ball-by-ball and other match-related updates. You can also turn to BCCI match centre for the latest updates related to the Hyderabad vs Mumbai SMAT match .
 Advertisement
 Suryakumar Yadav to Lead Mumbai Against Hyderabad
 Former India T20I captain Suryakumar Yadav will lead Mumbai in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026, adding significant experience to the team's batting line-up. Suryakumar was appointed captain by the Mumbai Cricket Association on November 9 and will be eager to make an impact in domestic cricket. The 36-year-old last featured in competitive cricket during IPL 2026 and will be looking to regain his rhythm ahead of India's upcoming assignments. Mumbai have some of the most dangerous batsmen in the world in their squad. The presence of Shivam Dube , Sarfaraz Khan, Shardul Thakur, Musheer Khan and Angkrish Raghuvanshi makes Mumbai a strong contender in Elite Group D. As a result, the fans will be looking forward to the Mumbai vs Hyderabad SMAT live streaming platforms.
